Slot: byte 1
Numerology: lower 4 bits of byte 2
Frame: lower 10 bits of byte 3 and 4

Num Carrier: byte 5
SKIP: bytes 6, 7, 8

Carrier ID: lower 2 bits of byte 9
RNTI Type: bit 2 to 5 of byte 9
Phychan Bit Mask: bit 6 and 7 from byte 9 and lower four bits of byte 10
    000010 == PUSCH
	000100 == PUCCH
    001000 == SRS
    010000 == PRACH
Dual Pol Status: bit 4 and 5 of byte 10
SKIP: bytes 11, 12
